_meta.purpose: Every phone number and legal line the app could show. Nothing here renders in a production build until someone has checked it against an official source and set verified to true.
_meta.rule: Only Abdelrahman flips a flag, after reading the official source. Until then the Shield screen shows the card, the name and a 'pending verification' line — never an invented number, and never a tel: link.
_meta.origin: Checked again on 16 Sep 2026 after Abdelrahman said the numbers were out of date. He is right, and it is worse than stale: the published sources disagree with each other. Each contact now carries a `candidates` list of every number anyone publishes for it, with where it was seen. Choosing between them is not something a search can do — psd.gov.jo is the authority and it is the one page that has to be read. Nothing renders until then.

legal.note: A statement about the law. It needs the official text and the article cited before it renders.

links.note: The official reporting form the reference build linked to. A URL the app sends someone to is the same kind of claim as a phone number: it renders only once somebody has opened it and confirmed it is the right form and still live.

The authority for all three numbers. A link is the honest form for something that changes: it cannot go stale the way a cached extension does, and checking it is opening it once. Open it, confirm it loads and carries the contact details, then flip.
The directorate's own page. Settles which of the three published numbers is current.
